why: Argo v3 is built route by route as the sibling app on the same API; this route lands once the layers it imports are frozen, so the owner sees live data on /v3/. Gated by G4 and the usage-explore Issue.
what: The usage tracking flow tab, columns, details and the route file route port: files named in owns, tests moved with them.
must_not_touch: apps/dashboard/**, apps/api/**, packages/shared/**, .basalt/**, apps/dashboard-v3/package.json and bun.lock (v3-argo-bump-g3/g4), other Issues' dirs under apps/dashboard-v3/src
contract: Read basalt-ui docs/v3/concepts/migration-release.md 6.1-6.3, argo DESIGN.md and the managed layer (.claude/rules/basalt-v3-*.md, skills basalt-v3-*). basalt-ui is pinned exact next.N (the gate's floor, v3-argo-bump in `after`): its docs/recipes and llms.txt are the API truth; never edit package.json or bun.lock. Never import apps/dashboard; share through @argo/shared. *.module.css files are not ported (classes replace them). This feature's model.ts, types.ts and tests are ported here.
exemplar: Follow apps/dashboard-v3/src/routes/__root.tsx, then the nearest landed route port, and the catalogue in .claude/skills/basalt-v3-design.
change: Port the flow tab (flow-model with its tests, flow-slot, flow-copy, flow-ink), router-column, router-detail, demand-column, workflow-detail and constants, and the route file that mounts both tabs (search key `view`: flow when absent, `view=explore`, as the old route does) with the explore components from v3-argo-route-usage-explore. model.ts and types.ts are v3-argo-route-usage-explore's. Rule: the app preset passes without new waivers. Skill snippet: none; recipes: the installed docs/recipes.
commits: Argo ships by push to master: conventional, one concern each, no attribution. Never edit node_modules or basalt-ui; a gap is a `friction:` line in the PR body, worked around in app code.
proof: `make design-shot APP=dashboard-v3 ROUTES="/usage-tracking"` (1440x900, 390x844) beside the old route's shots from APP=dashboard; basalt-design reviewer on the board; density equal or better; at most 3 rounds.
acceptance: `make check` exits 0 (runs check-v3: sync --check, doctor, lint, typecheck, build, test)

`bun scripts/check-test-port.ts apps/dashboard/src/features/usage-tracking apps/dashboard-v3/src/features/usage-tracking --only '{flow,router,demand,node-detail,workflow-detail,constants}*'` exits 0 and `bun --cwd apps/dashboard-v3 test src/features/usage-tracking` passes (changed lines carry `// port: <reason>` markers, listed in the PR)
`make design-shot APP=dashboard-v3 ROUTES="/usage-tracking"` writes 1440x900 and 390x844 shots against live data with no horizontal overflow at 390
`make verify-pages BASE=http://127.0.0.1:7737/v3 ROUTES=/usage-tracking` reports PASS after the factory deploy (`make version` = pushed sha), else not-run
`make verify-pages BASE=http://127.0.0.1:7737/v3 ROUTES=/usage-tracking?view=explore` reports PASS after the factory deploy (`make version` = pushed sha), else not-run
out_of_scope: Other routes, state and shell code, API changes.
